mcqs.question: Which place in Yemen was captured by the Houthis (Ansar Allah) in October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Houthis, also known as Ansar Allah, captured Turbah in Yemen. Mocha port and areas near Bab el-Mandeb had been captured earlier, while Dhubab was recaptured by the government operation “Dawn of Yemen.”

mcqs.question: What measure was approved by the Algerian Parliament in relation to deliberately setting destructive forest fires?
options: A de facto moratorium on executions
The use of the Algerian Dinar as a penalty
Recognition of Tamazight as an official language
mcqs.explanation: The Algerian Parliament approved a bill providing for the death penalty for deliberately setting destructive forest fires. The de facto moratorium on executions since 1993 is a separate fact, while the Algerian Dinar and Tamazight concern Algeria’s currency and language, respectively.
